big: In a mutual fund, your money is pooled with thousands of others. In a PMS, the shares sit in your own demat account. You can see every holding. But SEBI sets a minimum of ₹50 lakh.

lines: What makes a PMS different from a fund?
There is no pooling. The manager trades in your own demat account, so your portfolio and your tax position can differ from the next client's.
